deviation: The draft drops the requirement for written acceptance after a minimum 10 business days of testing, and instead has the Customer review within an undefined "reasonable period" and either accept or notify of non-conformity. This leaves open an argument that acceptance is implied if Arcadia doesn't respond in time, and it removes the guaranteed testing window. It also limits rejection to "material" non-conformities.
suggested_text: A Deliverable is accepted only when the Customer confirms acceptance in writing after not less than 10 business days of testing. There is no deemed acceptance. If a Deliverable does not conform to the specification, the Customer may notify the Supplier in writing, and the Supplier shall correct the non-conformity promptly at no additional charge and resubmit the Deliverable for a further testing period of not less than 10 business days. The Supplier shall notify the Customer without delay if it anticipates a delay to any milestone.
